title: Generative AI Business Case
short_desc: A business case on whether and how a global design team should start using generative AI. It weighs costs, benefits and risks.
role: Bachelor's thesis, written with a fellow student
problem: The LEGO Group's Graphic Design Team wanted to know if generative AI could help its designers, and at what cost.
built: We studied how generative AI could support the designers and compared different ways to introduce it. We weighed the time it could save against the cost and effort.
result: The report gave clear recommendations on legal risks, challenges in the organisation and the financial impact. The team's leadership wrote us a letter of recommendation.
tech_notes: We compared several implementation scenarios. For each one we weighed time saved for designers against cost and effort. The recommendations covered legal risk, challenges in the organisation and the financial impact.
